title: world
description: The root of a place: its tile grid, what it places off the grid, and what belongs to the place as a whole.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

provenance.description: Who wrote it, when, from what.

definition.description: A world defines nothing beyond its contents.

references.description: Other documents this one depends on.

grid.description: Tiles on a regular grid; a missing cell is a hole. Neighbours of cell (i, j) are cells (i +/- 1, j +/- 1).

tile.description: The id of the reference to the tile model placed in the cell, at origin + (i * axis_i + j * axis_j) * cell_size.

bounds_min.description: Minimum corner of the box the tile's terrain surface and liquids occupy, world frame.

placements.description: Placement sets the world places directly, off the grid: a map-wide building, and the map's fog and particulate volumes as effect instances.

items.description: The id of a placement set document's reference.

zones.description: Named regions of the world, nested (a subzone lies in its parent), each as the grid cells it covers. A cell lists only the zone its surface lies directly in: a zone's whole extent is its own cells and its descendants'.

name.description: Display name; absent when the source names none.

name_source.description: Where the name came from. Present exactly when name is.

id.description: This zone's stable id, unique among the world's zones.

parent.description: The id of the zone this one lies in; absent for a top-level zone.

cells.description: Cells part of whose surface lies directly in this zone. Empty for a zone whose ground is all subzones.

coverage.description: Fraction of the cell's surface lying directly in this zone.

id.description: The source's own record of the zone.

flags.description: AreaTable Flags[0] and Flags[1] as stored. Absent when the source has no area table.

mount_flags.description: AreaTable MountFlags as stored. Present exactly when flags is.

flag_names.description: Names of the set bits of flags[0], flags[1] and mount_flags, in that order, low bit first: wowdev.wiki DB/AreaTable's 10.2 tables (Area Flags, Area Flags2, Area Mount Flags). A set bit those tables don't name is only in the raw words. Present exactly when flags is.

map.description: The client's record of this map (its Map row, matched by Map.Directory to the WDT's directory): its name and what kind of place it is, which the WDT file name alone doesn't say. Values as stored. Absent when no map table was given or no row matches.

ref.description: The Map row, named from Map.MapName_lang.

directory.description: Map.Directory as stored: the map's folder under World\Maps\.

instance_type.description: Map.InstanceType as stored: whether the map is an open world or an instance, and which kind.

instance_type_name.description: instance_type's name from the WoWDBDefs Map.dbd column comment (0 none, 1 party, 2 raid, 3 pvp, 4 arena). Absent for a value that comment doesn't name.

map_type.description: Map.MapType as stored; no reliable source names its values.

expansion.description: Map.ExpansionID as stored: the expansion the map belongs to (0 the original game, 1 the first expansion, ...).

max_players.description: Map.MaxPlayers as stored: the instance's player cap; 0 on open-world maps.

parent.description: The map this one belongs to (Map.ParentMapID), a Map row named from its MapName_lang: e.g. a phased copy's original. Absent when stored as -1.

cosmetic_parent.description: The map this one looks like (Map.CosmeticParentMapID), a Map row named from its MapName_lang. Absent when stored as -1.

area.description: The map's own area (Map.AreaTableID), an AreaTable row named from AreaTable.AreaName_lang: what the client names the map's ground outside any zone. Absent when stored as 0.
